profile.headline: PhD in Computer Science | Senior AI, Computer Vision & HPC Software Engineer at NVIDIA
profile.summary: Dr. Zamora Ramos finished his PhD in 2017 with focus on Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Digital Image Processing, and Computer Graphics. With over 7 years of experience in the industry, he specializes in applied AI, software design, and engineering, applying his expertise to produce and support world-class products.

positions.title: AI Software Solutions Engineer
positions.description:
Role:
Research technical trends, provide technical leadership and advising, and apply domain expertise to prototype, develop and deliver optimized AI software solutions. Optimize performance of AI models for high-performance computing applications through deep knowledge and expertise of AI frameworks, algorithms, models, and related hardware, by adjusting operations, code, parameters, and/or quantization.

- SW Engineer and AI Researcher for the DARPA DPRIVE Program (https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/newsroom/news/intel-collaborate-microsoft-darpa-program.html)

positions.title: Machine Learning Software Engineer
positions.description:
Role:
Use or develop machine-learning algorithms, such as supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning and others, to solve applied problems in various disciplines such as Data Analytics, Computer Vision, Robotics, etc. Utilize current programming methodologies to translate machine learning models and data-processing methods into software. Complete programming, testing, debugging, documentation and/or deployment of the solution/products.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Role:
Various research topics.
Research deep learning and artificial neural networks; computer graphics and digital image processing  techniques for different applications in pattern recognition, encryption, ray tracing, solar panel optimization, etc. Use the National Supercomputing Institute Cherry Creek cluster for processor-intensive neural network tasks. Assist with, create and submit grant proposals.

projects.title: HEBench
projects.description: HEBench is an open-source flexible benchmarking framework for Homomorphic Encryption, provided by the HEBench Organization ( hebench.org ), that allows fair performance comparison among different implementations (in hardware and/or software) of a collection of homomorphic encryption workloads.
